Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring bereavement leave for employees of four-year institutions of higher education.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to bereavement leave at institutions of highereducation; adding a new section to chapter 28B.20 RCW; adding a newsection to chapter 28B.30 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 28B.35RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 28B.40 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28B.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Bereavement leave, not to exceed five days with pay, shall beallowed all academic, administrative, classified, and exempt employeesfor each death in the immediate family. As used in this section,"immediate family" means the mother, mother substitute, motherinlaw,father, father substitute, fatherinlaw, daughter, son, daughterinlaw, soninlaw, spouse, brother, sister, or grandchildren, of theemployee, or any relative living in the immediate household of theemployee.
